creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Today an accepted update rewrites the snapshot file in place and git diff is the
review surface. That is the right default, but it makes accepting an all-or-
nothing act on the whole file.

The layering already reserves the door: eval produces updated cases as data,
WriteFile takes an explicit target path, and `.snap.new` is a reserved extension
the discovery walk skips. So this is a call-site decision plus a review tool -
no format change.

Wait for a real need before building it. Right now the in-place flow plus
targeted -update= covers the workflow, and a half-built pending mode is worse
than none.
title: Pending-snapshot mode: write .snap.new instead of updating in place
